evidence: Source-only row 53 review. The authoritative frozen workbook Quality Checks A54:D54 and Internal Quality Checks A54:D54 require authored product behavior, domain fit and no nouns-swapped sibling; no additional internal annotation is present for this row. The frozen skill reference quality-checks.md:212-214 directs comparison with sibling names/concepts. The actual brief is specifically a local browser-code playground: task/instruction.md:1-7 asks for JS/HTML/CSS editing, adjacent execution, a snippet library, restoration of the last working preview, and protection against two editors overwriting newer work. These are developed into coherent product rules in environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5-15 (fresh execution contexts, Stop/supersession, shared deadlines, completed-preview interaction, rollback and authored-source error lines), :19-29 (console, debounce and revision-safe saved snippets), and security.md:3-11 (snippet execution boundaries). task.toml:5-15 consistently identifies the code-playground/devtools domain and states adaptation from the supplied Colderwater task. NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:195-203 permits shared infrastructure while requiring distinct domain behavior; TASK_AUTHORING_WORKFLOW.md:40-58 requires cohesive, motivated workflows. Closest sibling comparison: PatchPad is a long incident-report editor (projects/patchpad-editor-v3/instruction.md:3-5), with word/grapheme navigation, multicaret editing, atomic undo and find/replace (its environment/assets/instructions/editing.md:3-52), plus historical revision preview/restore (persistence.md:6-15). GridForge centers on cell/range selection and formula references/recalculation (projects/gridforge-spreadsheet-v3/environment/assets/instructions/spreadsheet.md:3-41). Boardloom centers on geometry, attached connectors, linked component instances and groups (projects/boardloom-infinite-canvas/environment/assets/behaviour.md:3-35); Ridgeline centers on print stock, checkout, retry and cancellation (projects/ridgeline-print-storefront/instruction.md:1-9). Colderwater shares ordinary editing/persistence concerns but does not reuse those defining workflows or criterion inventory. Its functional criteria are concretely playground-specific: tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:45-105 grades filename dispatch, CSS sample preview, late interaction and active/completed Stop behavior; :163-196 grades literal execution deadlines and exact source-error recovery; :541-574 adds HTML/CSS supersession and late-interaction failure observations. The inspected implementation likewise contains actual preview lifecycle handling, snapshot restoration and run-token message routing in solution/app/src/runtime.ts:350-389, connected to editor Run and Save in src/app.tsx:44-73 and revision-aware server writes in server.js:52-89. These source observations substantiate authorship, not full functional correctness. Counterexample considered: merely rename PatchPad reports to snippets and add a canned preview. Such a product cannot satisfy the newly authored DOM-and-console marker demanded by tests/gates/render/judge.toml, and it lacks the execution-specific scored outcomes above. Conforming alternative considered: use a different editor component, layout, labels, route schema and example set while preserving the requested run and library behavior. Public integration.md:3, policy.md:5-7 and ui.md:7 allow those choices, and both gate criteria match controls/outcomes without requiring golden selectors or a JSON list endpoint. Reused template infrastructure and broadly useful conflict safety do not establish cloning.
